highlights: ideal first investors and first time buyers
description:
Immaculately refurbished to a good standard is this great home in a convenient location. With newly fitted kitchen and recently decorated throughout, the property is situated close to the mainline train station, local schools and shops. Ideal for investors and first time buyers, viewing is recommended. The accommodation is entered via glazed door which opens into the entrance vestibule. There is access to a spacious living room with fireplace and understairs cupboard. A doorway leads into a good sized kitchen/dining room which has been refurbished with grey gloss units. To the first floor is a landing area, two bedrooms and bathroom. The main bedroom is a good sized double and the second is a spacious single. The bathroom is also a spacious room with three piece suite. Outside to the front the property has on street parking and is within close proximity to parkland, schools and shops. To the rear is an enclosed yard with outhouse and access gate.

ENTRANCE VESTIBULE With staircase to the first floor and access to:

LIVING ROOM Reception room with fireplace, understairs storage cupboard and window to front.

KITCHEN/DINING ROOM Good sized room with door and window to rear and re-fitted with grey gloss units, worktop with upstand, freestanding cooker with extractor above, sink unit and space for appliances. There is also space for dining furniture.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with window to front.

BEDROOM TWO

Spacious single room with window to rear.

BATHROOM

Further good sized room with storage cupboard, window to rear and partially tiled with suite comprising bath with overhead shower, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY To the front the property has on street parking and is within close proximity to parkland, schools and shops. To the rear is an enclosed yard with outhouse and access gate.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note: All measurements including floorplans are approximate only. We have been advised that recently carried out works mentioned above were completed in 2023.
